{{armor art infobox | campaign = [[Eye of the North]] | pvp = Highlander Woad | pvpreward = Basic | specialgallery = Highlander Woad }} '''Highlander Woad''' is a prestige headgear art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Slayer of Wurms) in the [[Norn title track]] to be able to craft this armor. 5 {{Ink}} |} ==Dye== The grey side can be [[dye]]d. {{dye chart}} ==Notes== [[Image:Highlanderwoad.jpg|thumb|Glitched woad.]] * All characters will have the left side of their face dyed white while wearing this item, depending on your skin tone. Females have the left side of their face whiter. * Certain character faces have a little strip of the color dye on the un-dyed side of the face. * Depending upon your character's face, your eyebrows may be hidden while wearing this item. ==Trivia== * [[w:woad|Woad]] is the name of a plant that was historically used to make blue dye. * This is the facepaint style of [[w:William_Wallace|William Wallace]] in the film [[w:Braveheart|Braveheart]]. ==See also== *[[Norn Woad]] {{Common armor nav}} [[Category:Common armor|Highlander Woad]] [[Category:Prestige armor]]
